intro: Vati A I Tax Intelligence, for the R S L Taxathon, Challenge 2. We follow one refund claim from the taxpayer, to a risk-selected case, to a human, evidence-backed decision.
s01: Scene one. A taxpayer files a VAT refund claim.
Taxpayer portal: The taxpayer portal shows a business only its own submissions, and their review status.
Submission status: Status is in plain language, mirrored from case management. Risk scores and officer detail never reach the browser.
New VAT refund claim: A new refund claim is a guided, step by step form.
Claim details: The tax period, amounts and reason are validated before anything is sent.
Supporting documents: Supporting documents are checked for type and size, then stored as private, hashed evidence.
Purchase invoices: Each purchase invoice behind the claim feeds automated VAT consistency checks.
Check your claim: The taxpayer reviews everything, then signs the declaration.
Claim sent: The claim is sent once. Retrying is safe, and never creates a duplicate.
Auditor workspace: Officers see their assigned cases by status, straight from Jube case management.
Risk-selected case queue: Each case in the queue shows the risk signals that selected it.
Case detail: The case brings together the selection reasons, the taxpayer summary, and processing status.
Evidence: Evidence documents carry their extraction state, and S H A 256 integrity hashes.
Entity relationships: Relationships show linked companies, directors and accounts.
AI-assisted findings: A I findings are review material, not decisions. Every one cites its source record.
Evidence record: An evidence record shows its version history, its hash, and every finding that relies on it.
Review and decide: On the review page, agent suggestions only pre-fill the form. A human always decides.
Officer rationale: The officer writes the rationale in their own words.
Confirm before acting: Every consequential action is confirmed first.
Decision proposed: The decision now waits for a different supervisor to approve it. Separation of duties is built in.
s03: Scene three. A supervisor oversees the work.
Management dashboard: Supervisors see workload, elapsed time, unresolved evidence, and legal route coverage.
Audit assurance: These figures are measured from case, decision, evidence and audit ledger records.
Integrity review: The integrity review aggregates policy exposure, overrides and review signals, combining small groups to protect privacy.
outro: Vati A I. Explainable, evidence first, and human decided. Thank you.
